identical_applicable_criteria.criterion: Match actor, conduct, object, polarity, trigger, duration, and exceptions exactly. Limited use is supported only by an operative sole-purpose, necessary-purpose, or no-other-purpose restriction; nondisclosure, confidentiality, ownership, or a definition alone does not restrict use. Cite all independently operative use restrictions and any incorporated purpose or exception needed to delimit them, but omit adjacent security and disclosure provisions. Compelled-disclosure notice requires notice or consultation responsive to a legal, regulatory, court, governmental, or comparable compulsory demand; breach, loss, incident, or unauthorized-disclosure reporting is not equivalent. Cite the compulsory-disclosure trigger and notice duty, plus a governing exception introduction only when it supplies their legal effect. Reverse engineering requires an express prohibition on reverse engineering, disassembly, decompilation, or an expressly equivalent act directed to the protected object; never infer it from identifiability, privacy, no-copy, ownership, no-license, or limited-use terms. No solicitation requires an express prohibition on soliciting, inducing, enticing, employing, or retaining the specified employees or representatives; contacting sources, using names, advertising, or disclosure restrictions do not qualify. Express permission for the same conduct is Contradiction; neighboring regulation or silence is NotMentioned. Include a qualification or duration only when it changes the responsive duty.

identical_applicable_criteria.criterion: Look for operative language that the agreement or disclosure grants the receiving party no license, title, interest, ownership, immunity, or other right in the confidential information or associated intellectual property. Express retained or exclusive ownership can support the no-right conclusion when it directly negates acquisition by the recipient; read scoped exceptions and any affirmative grant before deciding. An affirmative grant opposes the hypothesis only when it gives the receiving party a right in the same protected object. Do not infer a non-grant from a confidentiality definition, nondisclosure duty, permitted-use restriction, entire-agreement clause, remedy, disclaimer, or no-warranty language. Cite every independently operative ownership or non-grant sentence that contributes to the conclusion, but exclude warranty, accuracy, commercialization, or administrative language unless it itself grants or withholds the relevant right. If neither a grant nor a non-grant is expressed, return NotMentioned.

identical_applicable_criteria.criterion: Read the governing exclusions or limitations and keep the two provenance routes separate. Independent-development support requires a clause saying the receiving party developed the information independently, normally without using, accessing, referring to, or relying on protected information. Prior possession, authorized use, a substantive information category, a warranty disclaimer, or receipt from another source does not establish development. Third-party-acquisition support requires receipt, disclosure, or lawful obtainment by the receiving party from a third party entitled to provide the information and not bound by the relevant restriction. A clause merely saying the disclosing party gave information to another person, or that information was independently developed, does not establish third-party acquisition. Cite the exclusion introduction when it supplies the consequence, the exact provenance prong, and any proof, no-use, lawful-source, or no-confidentiality condition. An express prohibition on the same route is Contradiction; absence of the exact route is NotMentioned.

identical_applicable_criteria.criterion: Inspect the receiving party's specific authority to make, reproduce, duplicate, or record a copy. Support requires affirmative operative permission, such as copying reasonably necessary for the stated purpose. A default prohibition on copying or reproduction opposes the hypothesis even when copying could occur with prior consent; a consent mechanism is not present permission unless another provision affirmatively authorizes the relevant copying. Do not infer creation authority from use, access, possession, recordkeeping, reducing information to writing, delivery or return of existing copies, or permission to retain one existing archival copy. When a prohibition contains an internal copying exception, cite both the prohibition and the exception if both define the permission; otherwise cite only the operative actor, copying verb, modality, and controlling condition. If the document addresses neighboring handling acts without settling creation of copies, return NotMentioned.
